Name: Staircase Guard
Author: Malenyaaa
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
When you place a staircase in the Mines or Skull Cavern, the ladder takes a moment to appear, so it's easy to click again and waste a second one. With this mod, once you placed a staircase on a level, further staircases there are blocked and stay in your inventory. Hold Shift to place another one anyway.

The code for this mod was written with help from an AI. Idea and in-game testing are mine.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Download this mod and unzip it into your Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Only one staircase per mine level: further ones are blocked and stay in your inventory.
- Hold Shift to place another one anyway. The key can be changed, controller buttons work too.
- Place a staircase on the tile you're standing on, which the game normally doesn't allow (can be turned off).
- A short hint above the toolbar tells you when a staircase was blocked (can be turned off).
- Works in the Mines and Skull Cavern. Every new level starts fresh.
- Settings via Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json: Enabled, OverrideKey, AllowUnderPlayer, ShowHint.
- Translations: English, German.
- Open source (MIT): https://github.com/Malenyaaa/stardew-mods[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
- SMAPI (required): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to Pathoschild for SMAPI and the mod build tools, to spacechase0 for Generic Mod Config Menu, and to the players on the Steam forums who kept losing staircases to double clicks.[/color]
